cells.gaps: The 510 is a count of local government administration offices with no total of offices and no number of local governments, unchanged from July 2025 to 17 December 2025; where the offices are, who provides or pays for the connections and what is done over them are not stated. The 96% of 13 November 2025 (NGA-031) names local government areas on a health ministry platform and not the office, and its source states no institutional connection, so it disagrees with the count and sets nothing; the DHIS2 entry at LGA offices (NGA-032, NGA-033) is dated 2024 and 2021, names no connection and gives no number. On owner the rows disagree: ministry as implementing agency at 24 July 2026, a majority-private company, not yet incorporated, in the August and September 2026 rows; no domestic budget line is stated.
cells.note: Offices are counted as connected to broadband, institutionally, on a count with no total, which is the stage 3 row; stage 4 needs more than half on a share or a count with a denominator from a source that states the institutional connection. The advancing events of the twelve months are Project BRIDGE's financing and timetable, with no office yet connected by it.
